recent.text: Update: #Magic guard Jalen Suggs (right knee bone bruise) is “progressing positively” and “continues in his return-to-play protocols, including court work,” the team told the @orlandosentinel. His return will depend on how he responds to increased court activities, the team said.
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: “It’s great to be back,” #Magic guard Desmond Bane, who missed Saturday at Golden State due to an illness, told @Kendra_Melinda and @Josh_Cohen_NBA Monday. “I don’t like being away from the team, being bunkered down in my room. But I’m feeling better.” More below: 🎥: @Magic_PR https://t.co/0PZGyHnpPU
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: When asked by @Josh_Cohen_NBA for an update Monday, #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Desmond Bane, who missed Saturday’s game at Golden State due to an illness, is feeling better. In addition, Sweeney said Anthony Black, who exited due to cramps, is also doing good. Full updates: https://t.co/x4Ineaf47F

recent.text: My latest for @orlandosports: No #Magic margin for error in loss at Warriors with Kings up next: “I thought a lot of guys stepped up and played really aggressive,” Franz Wagner said. “Tough to not come out with the win, but we’ll build on it.” More: https://t.co/Q0d6JRA0lC
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: My @orlandosports recap as the shorthanded #Magic fall in OT at the Warriors, lose their 4th in a row: “The thing with him is, he’s never done,” Orlando coach Sean Sweeney said about Golden State’s Stephen Curry, who had 41 points. https://t.co/qjFxg32oi7
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: Asked by @Josh_Cohen_NBA how tough it can be to slow down Golden State’s Steph Curry, #Magic forward Franz Wagner had this to say: “Yeah, it’s really tough. He had a hell of a game. But I think we can take a lot of good things from tonight. And a lot of things we can build on.”
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: When asked by @Josh_Cohen_NBA for an update postgame on Anthony Black, #Magic coach Sean Sweeney said Black had a cramp at Golden State. Black exited the game with 2:47 left in OT and didn’t return. It looked like he was getting his left leg worked on while sitting on the bench.
recent.author: Jason Beede

recent.text: The two missed free throws from Carter looming very large. Curry got a floater past Franz to make it a four-point game. #Magic haven't been able to get Franz a clean look for most of the fourth and OT. Living on Tristan threes and offensive rebounds. ORL 118:122 GSW 0:24 OT

recent.text: The #Warriors are doing a much better job getting the ball out of Franz's hands with blitzes and traps than the #Magic are with Stephen Curry. They seem fine with Curry beating them if the shots are tough (they mostly have been). Carter missed 2 FTs ORL 118:120 GSW 1:09 OT

recent.text: There is a lot to say about Jase Richardson. We can debate whether he should start and they need more offensively. But that kid scraps. He is mixing it up for offensive rebounds. Constantly fighting. That's always a start. ORL 78:75 GSW 0:17.9 3rd

recent.text: Anthony Black with a three-pointer. Missed another, Jase rebound, Black and-1. It's been a lot of doom and gloom around this team all week. Real credit to them after that first half to stick with it and get back into this game. #Magic on a 17-5 run. ORL 78:73 GSW 0:40 3d
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: The #Magic take their first lead of the game on a Tristan da Silva three. They have strung together shots. But they are playing with a lot more poise, dictating tempo on both sides. Defense has been really strong tonight. ORL 72:69 GSW 2:46 3rd
recent.author: Orlando Magic Daily

recent.text: Hey, Franz Wagner is 3 for 5 from three! Motion looks a lot more fluid than in previous games. The #Magic are fighting here, as poorly as they are shooting. ORL 58:65 GSW 6:52 3rd
